staffThesis.not: 30 bodies to fill a Tuesday practice
staffThesis.resourcing: NIL market decides how many of those 10-12 Florida can actually buy. Sumrall said that out loud.
staffThesis.qbGate: Identify whether the 2027 starter is already on the roster (Philo, Jones Jr., Griffin). If yes, spend the money around him. If no, a portal QB taxes the tackle budget.

rosterSnapshot.depthChartNote: Official two-deep on disk is still Week 10 Oklahoma. Use it as last stamped two-deep, not Vanderbilt week.
rosterSnapshot.incomingPortalNote: getPortalBoard() is empty because last winter's UF transfers are already on the 2026 roster. Winter 2027 targets have not been written into the fan store — on purpose.

needs.why: Sumrall / SI: both tackle spots are immediate needs and the most expensive portal buy. HS incoming Hutcheson and Fisher are 2027 true freshmen — not Year-1 SEC starters. Listed LT Lovett and RT Ugorji (Jones has taken snaps) have not locked the room.
needs.hunt: Power conference tackle who can start in 2027. Length, 2+ years left. Two if the budget holds.

needs.why: Hiller is the 5-star interior. Miller arrives with him. Not a 10-12 portal slot unless a Year-1 starter falls.
Starter Bryce Thornton is a senior. DJ Coleman and Alfonzo Allen Jr. are also on one year. Returning two-deep is Cam Dooley and Lagonza Hayward. 2027 class has one safety (3-star Kailib Dillard).
needs.hunt: Range-and-tackle safety who can play SS or STAR in Year 1. 2+ years left.

needs.why: Staff/beat (SI, Gainesville Sun) named the secondary as a portal shop. Jordy Lowery and Javion Toombs are on one year. Hanks / Flowers / McClain are the live room. Four 2027 CB commits (Floyd, Fountain, Nugent, Whitfield) are incoming freshmen. Quality starter snaps still look thin.
needs.hunt: Press-man corner with starter snaps. Do not treat podcast McClain-leave talk as a fact.

needs.why: SI: interior DL depends on outgoing. Kamran James (starter, Sr.) and Emmanuel Oyebadejo (listed with James / McCray, R-Sr.) are on one year. Bett / McCloud / McCray return. Two 2027 DL commits (Tookes, Kendrick).
needs.hunt: Year-1 interior who can two-gap. Only if James / Oyebadejo are actually gone.

needs.why: Sumrall, Nov 17: wants the next two weeks (Vanderbilt, then FSU, then a bowl) to answer whether the 2027 starter is on this team. Philo just won SEC Offensive Player of the Week vs Kentucky. Jones Jr. started Texas. Griffin is getting scout-team/game-ready reps, not a throw-him-out plan. A portal QB taxes the tackle budget.
needs.hunt: Only if the staff decides the 2027 starter is not Philo / Jones / Griffin. Do not publish a QB name until that call is made.

needs.why: MIKE starter Jaden Robinson is a senior. TJ Bullard is R-Sr. Graham / Chiles / Ty Jackson / Myles Johnson return. Three 2027 LBs (Ja'Bios Smith, McGaskin, Geathers).
needs.hunt: Only a difference-maker. Not a depth body.

needs.why: Jayden Woods is the So. starter. Kofi Asare is R-Sr. One 2027 EDGE (Cahron Wheeler).
needs.hunt: Pass-rush piece who can play JACK. Not a 30-man roster filler.

needs.why: Eric Singleton Jr. (Sr. starter) and Kahleil Jackson (Gr.) are on the way out. Wilson, Vernell Brown III, Stockton return. Four 2027 WR commits including Royal. Headcount is fine. A true WR1 if Singleton is not back would still be a dude, not a body.
needs.hunt: Only if Singleton is gone and the staff wants a Year-1 WR1. Royal is a freshman.

needs.why: Baugh is Jr. with two years. Pryor is the only one-year back. Beard and Grant arrive. Do not spend a portal slot here unless Baugh's situation changes.
Dippre is R-Jr. Harpring / Amir Jackson return. Douglas and Ballinger arrive. Not a 10-12 slot unless a difference-maker falls.

namedCandidatesRule: No invented names. A player lands on this list only with a verified beat or On3 item that he is in the portal, or a Florida staff/beat link. Podcast wish lists (e.g. Bryce Underwood) stay off this board.
doNot: Write these rooms or hunts onto /vault/portal until Charles says ship.
Upsert category=portal into the recruiting store from this file.
Treat eligibility 1 as a confirmed departure — five-for-five can bring seniors back.
Force a portal QB while Sumrall is still answering that in-house.
